name: cc-pulse
description: macOS向け自動ニュース収集CLIツール - Claude Agent SDK統合

scripts.setup: bun install && bun run src/cli.ts setup
scripts.build: bun run build:css && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cc-pulse-darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cc-pulse-darwin-x64
scripts.build:arm64: bun run build:css && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cc-pulse-darwin-arm64
scripts.build:x64: bun run build:css && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cc-pulse-darwin-x64
